title: Pathwise uniqueness for the SPDE of super-Brownian motion in one dimension
open_core: Does pathwise uniqueness hold for du = (1/2) u_xx dt + sqrt(u) dW with space-time white noise among nonnegative solutions?
known_from_memory_to_verify: Weak uniqueness by duality; Mytnik-Perkins give pathwise uniqueness for Holder coefficients of index above 3/4; non-uniqueness for signed solutions (Mueller-Mytnik-Perkins).

title: The matrix Spencer conjecture
open_core: For symmetric n x n matrices A_1..A_n of operator norm at most 1 there are signs with norm of the signed sum O(sqrt n).
known_from_memory_to_verify: Bansal-Jiang-Meka (2023) for rank at most n/polylog n; general case open.

title: The second Kahn-Kalai conjecture
open_core: The threshold for G(n,p) to contain a copy of a fixed-shape graph H is at most a constant times log v(H) times the largest expectation threshold over subgraphs of H.
known_from_memory_to_verify: Park-Pham proved the first conjecture (2022); Mossel-Niles-Weed-Sun-Zadik a modified form; later partial results to be checked.

title: Anti-concentration of the permanent of a Gaussian matrix (Aaronson-Arkhipov)
open_core: P(|Per X| < sqrt(n!)/p(n, 1/delta)) < delta for an n x n complex Gaussian matrix.
known_from_memory_to_verify: Tao-Vu: the Bernoulli permanent is nonzero with high probability; weak anti-concentration only.

title: The Bilu-Linial signing conjecture
open_core: Every d-regular graph has a signing of its adjacency matrix with spectral radius at most 2 sqrt(d-1).
known_from_memory_to_verify: Marcus-Spielman-Srivastava: one-sided bound, which gives bipartite Ramanujan graphs of every degree; the two-sided statement is open.

title: Maximum cut and minimum bisection of random regular graphs (Zdeborova-Boettcher)
open_core: For random d-regular graphs the max cut and min bisection satisfy mc + mb = |E| + o(n), and the constants are given by the Parisi-type formulae.
known_from_memory_to_verify: Dembo-Montanari-Sen: leading order in large d; Coja-Oghlan et al. for bounds at fixed d.

title: The Mihail-Vazirani conjecture
open_core: The graph of every 0/1 polytope has edge expansion at least 1.
known_from_memory_to_verify: Anari-Liu-Oveis Gharan-Vinzant: matroid base polytopes; general 0/1 polytopes open.

title: The effective mass of the Frohlich polaron (Landau-Pekar)
open_core: m_eff(alpha)/alpha^4 converges to the Landau-Pekar constant as alpha tends to infinity.
known_from_memory_to_verify: Order alpha^4 from above (Brooks-Seiringer) and below (Bazaes-Mukherjee-Sellke-Varadhan); the constant is open.

title: Non-extinction of the Fleming-Viot particle system (Burdzy-Holyst-March)
open_core: In every bounded domain the N-particle Fleming-Viot system driven by Brownian motion has no accumulation of jumps in finite time, and its stationary empirical law converges to the quasi-stationary law.
known_from_memory_to_verify: Lipschitz domains with small constant (Bieniek-Burdzy-Finch); extinction possible with strong drift.

title: The second-order term in the two-dimensional random matching problem
open_core: E W_2^2 between n uniform points and Lebesgue measure on the square equals log n/(4 pi n) + c/n + o(1/n) with the constant predicted by Caracciolo-Lucibello-Parisi-Sicuro.
known_from_memory_to_verify: Ambrosio-Stra-Trevisan: leading term; Ambrosio-Glaudo-Trevisan: error bounds.

title: The critical two-dimensional stochastic heat flow and the two-dimensional KPZ equation at criticality
open_core: Universality of the critical 2D stochastic heat flow as the limit of every directed polymer and mollified SHE in the critical window, and a solution theory for 2D KPZ at the critical coupling.
known_from_memory_to_verify: Caravenna-Sun-Zygouras: existence of the flow; Tsai: axiomatic characterisation.

title: Percolation of words (Benjamini-Kesten)
open_core: For site percolation on Z^d with p = 1/2 and d at least 3, is every infinite binary word seen along some self-avoiding path almost surely?
known_from_memory_to_verify: Almost every word for d at least 10 (Benjamini-Kesten); every word on the close-packed triangular-type lattices (Kesten-Sidoravicius-Zhang).

title: Poisson-Dirichlet law of the macroscopic cycles of spatial random permutations in three dimensions
open_core: The normalised long cycle lengths of the interchange process and of the Feynman-Kac representation of the Bose gas on a d-dimensional box, d at least 3, converge to PD(1).
known_from_memory_to_verify: Schramm: complete graph; Elboim-Peled and others for mean-field and special models. Strengthens T012.

title: Asymptotic independence in the supermarket model with general service times
open_core: For join-the-shortest-of-d queues with general service law, any fixed number of queues become independent in equilibrium as the number of servers grows, at every load below 1.
known_from_memory_to_verify: Bramson-Lu-Prabhakar: decreasing hazard rate or light load.

title: False discovery rate control of Benjamini-Hochberg for two-sided Gaussian tests
open_core: Does the Benjamini-Hochberg procedure control the FDR at level alpha for two-sided tests of the means of a multivariate normal vector with arbitrary covariance?
known_from_memory_to_verify: True under PRDS (one-sided, nonnegative correlation); two-sided case open beyond n = 2.

title: Invariance of the Phi^4_3 Gibbs measure under the three-dimensional cubic nonlinear Schrodinger equation
open_core: Almost sure global well-posedness and invariance for cubic NLS on T^3 with data distributed by the Phi^4_3 measure.
known_from_memory_to_verify: Bringmann-Deng-Nahmod-Yue: the cubic wave equation.

title: Griffiths inequalities for the classical Heisenberg model
open_core: Does the second Griffiths inequality <S_A S_B> - <S_A><S_B> >= 0 hold for the ferromagnetic O(3) model?
known_from_memory_to_verify: Ginibre: O(2); Sylvester's counterexamples for some observables at N at least 3.

title: Strict convexity of the surface tension for gradient interface models with non-convex potentials
open_core: Is the surface tension of the grad-phi model strictly convex for every non-convex potential with quadratic growth, and are the ergodic gradient Gibbs measures unique at each tilt?
known_from_memory_to_verify: Cotar-Deuschel-Muller at high temperature; Biskup-Kotecky non-uniqueness at tilt zero.

title: Regular Lagrangian points of Burgers turbulence with fractional Brownian initial velocity (Sinai; She-Aurell-Frisch)
open_core: For inviscid Burgers with fBm initial velocity of index H, the set of Lagrangian regular points has Hausdorff dimension H.
known_from_memory_to_verify: Sinai: H = 1/2.

title: The sharp constant in the multivariate Dvoretzky-Kiefer-Wolfowitz inequality
open_core: The best C(d) in P(sup |F_n - F| > t) <= C(d) exp(-2 n t^2) for distribution functions on R^d.
known_from_memory_to_verify: Massart: C(1) = 2; Naaman: C(d) <= d(n+1), dependence on n not expected to be needed.

title: The mobility edge for Levy matrices and for sparse Erdos-Renyi graphs
open_core: A sharp transition between localised and delocalised eigenvectors at an energy E(alpha) for Levy matrices with alpha below 1, and the analogous statement for G(n, c/n).
known_from_memory_to_verify: Bordenave-Guionnet; Aggarwal-Bordenave-Lopatto for alpha near 0 and 1; Alt-Ducatez-Knowles for the critical Erdos-Renyi regime.

title: Convergence of N-player games to mean-field games without monotonicity
open_core: Characterise the limits of N-player Nash equilibria when the mean-field game has several solutions and the master equation has no classical solution.
known_from_memory_to_verify: Cardaliaguet-Delarue-Lasry-Lions under monotonicity; Lacker for weak limits; selection results in examples.

title: Global well-posedness of the dynamical sine-Gordon model in the full subcritical regime
open_core: Global-in-time solutions and invariance of the sine-Gordon measure for every beta^2 below 8 pi.
known_from_memory_to_verify: Hairer-Shen and Chandra-Hairer-Shen: local theory to 8 pi; Bringmann-Cao: global to 6 pi.

title: Multidimensional backward stochastic differential equations with quadratic growth (Peng)
open_core: Find sharp conditions for existence and uniqueness of systems of quadratic BSDEs with bounded terminal data.
known_from_memory_to_verify: Tevzadze: small data; Xing-Zitkovic: Markovian case; Frei-dos Reis counterexample.

title: The Bak-Sneppen model
open_core: Is the critical threshold of the Bak-Sneppen model on the cycle strictly below 1 (numerically 0.667), and do avalanches have power-law tails?
known_from_memory_to_verify: Meester-Znamenski: non-triviality bounds; Gillett-Meester-van der Wal on related models.

title: The graph-distance exponent of critical long-range percolation
open_core: For long-range percolation on Z^d with connection probability beta/|x-y|^(2d), identify the exponent theta(beta) of the graph distance.
known_from_memory_to_verify: Ding-Sly and Baeumler: existence, continuity and monotonicity of theta.

title: The extremal GI/GI/1 queue (Kingman; Daley)
open_core: The tight upper bound on the mean stationary waiting time given the first two moments of the interarrival and service laws is attained by two-point laws.
known_from_memory_to_verify: Kingman and Daley bounds; Chen-Whitt numerical evidence and partial proofs.

title: Optimal scheduling in the M/G/k queue
open_core: Which policy minimises mean response time in the M/G/k queue, at every load?
known_from_memory_to_verify: SRPT-k and Gittins-k are optimal in heavy traffic (Grosof-Scully-Harchol-Balter).

title: Dimension dependence in the central limit theorem over convex sets
open_core: Is the factor d^(1/4) in Bentkus's bound for sup over convex sets of |P(S_n in A) - P(Z in A)| optimal?
known_from_memory_to_verify: Bentkus (2003): d^(1/4) E|X|^3 / sqrt n; Nagaev's lower bounds leave a gap.

title: Uniform equilibria in stochastic games with three or more players
open_core: Does every finite stochastic game with at least three players have a uniform epsilon-equilibrium payoff?
known_from_memory_to_verify: Vieille: two players; Solan: three-player absorbing games.

title: The rate of Muller's ratchet
open_core: The asymptotic rate at which the fittest class is lost in the Haigh model as the population size grows.
known_from_memory_to_verify: Etheridge-Pfaffelhuber-Wakolbinger: diffusion approximations and the predicted rate; no proof.

title: The chemical distance exponent of critical planar percolation
open_core: Does the expected length of the shortest open crossing of an n x n box at criticality behave as n^s, and what is s?
known_from_memory_to_verify: Aizenman-Burchard: s > 1; Damron-Hanson-Sosoe: the chemical distance is of smaller order than the lowest crossing.

title: The spectral radius of simple random walk on surface groups
open_core: Determine the spectral radius of the standard random walk on the fundamental group of the closed surface of genus 2.
known_from_memory_to_verify: Rigorous numerical bounds (Bartholdi, Nagnibeda, Gouezel); no closed form.

title: Sampling satisfying assignments of bounded-degree k-CNF formulas
open_core: Find the largest degree d(k) for which solutions of a k-CNF with variable degree d can be sampled almost uniformly in polynomial time; conjecturally of order 2^(k/2).
known_from_memory_to_verify: Hardness above 5 * 2^(k/2) (Bezakova et al.); algorithms to about 2^(k/5) (Moitra; Feng-Guo-Yin-Zhang; He-Wang-Yin).

title: Detecting latent geometry in sparse random geometric graphs (Bubeck-Ding-Eldan-Racz)
open_core: For random geometric graphs on the sphere S^(d-1) with average degree of constant order, geometry is detectable exactly when d is below order log^3 n.
known_from_memory_to_verify: Brennan-Bresler-Nagaraj; Liu-Mohanty-Schramm-Yang up to polylogarithmic factors.

title: The constants in the higher-dimensional Ulam problem (Bollobas-Winkler)
open_core: The longest chain among n uniform points in the d-cube is asymptotic to c_d n^(1/d); determine c_d for d at least 3 and the fluctuation exponent.
known_from_memory_to_verify: c_2 = 2; c_d < e and c_d tends to e (Bollobas-Winkler).
